name: smart-pcmt
title: WHO SMART Guidelines — Product Catalogue (PCMT)
description: The WHO SMART Product Catalog implementation guide (FHIR IG source under input/), as a harnessed instance of smart-base, in the shape of smart-immunizations. Downstream of litlfred/dth-pc (owner, 2026-10-31): its logical models and terms align to the product catalogue concepts dth-pc defines (Generic Product, Trade Item, Regulated Trade Item, Product Master Data) and never redefine them. Plan: litlfred/smart-ra#145.

directories.description: BPMN 2.0 business process diagrams for the WHO-hosted Product Catalogue Management Tool (PCMT), starting with PC-BP-09-pcmt-access.bpmn (handbook Ch 6, pp. 46-47, Fig. 14; litlfred/smart-ra#145, litlfred/dth-pc#2 §2e).

DMN 1.3 decision tables for the WHO-hosted Product Catalogue Management Tool (PCMT), starting with PC-DT-03.dmn (catalogue access matrix user group × catalogue → view / edit / own, handbook Ch 6, p. 47, Fig. 14; litlfred/smart-ra#145, litlfred/dth-pc#2 §2e).
What auditing THIS instance produced: one QA verdict sidecar per audited subject. Stored on the cat/cat-harness/qa-reports branch keyed by commit, as smart-immunizations declares its own.

_needs_comment: Dependency chain: smart-ra <- dth-sc <- dth-pc <- smart-pcmt (owner, 2026-10-31; litlfred/smart-ra#145, litlfred/dth-pc#2). smart-pcmt is downstream of dth-pc and aligns its logical models, glossary terms, processes, and decision tables to the product catalogue concepts dth-pc defines, which in turn link to dth-sc and dpi-h-ra (smart-ra). smart-base provides the SMART Guidelines base IG and DAK conventions.
